A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same complete, readable 14-page DSDBench paper, including Appendices A-E. Text and rendered-page comparisons confirm identical substantive content; only the first-page arXiv version/date stamp differs.

before.justification: Section 4 reports original model evaluations, self-refinement experiments, and diagnostic analyses on DSDBench. Appendix E provides full numerical results in Tables 7-10.

after.justification: Section 4 and Appendix E retain the same original experimental results, including single-bug and multi-bug model evaluations and self-refinement outcomes.

M1.justification: The error-injection, direct-generation, execution-tracing, annotation, verification, and self-debugging procedures are identical, including their descriptions in Appendices A-B.

E1.justification: Both versions retain the same DABench, MatPlotBench, and DSEval sources, DSDBench debugging scenarios, and DABench-Hard self-refinement task. No dataset, domain, or task coverage changes.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical within the corresponding experiments in Tables 3-4 and 7-10. Figure 4 also retains the same direct-solution, self-refinement, and component-removal comparisons.

E3.justification: Both use identical zero-shot prompts, temperature-zero decoding, scoring rules, and evaluation samples. The LRM comparison retains its subset of 96 single-error and 40 multi-error instances.

E4.justification: The self-refinement ablations, error-type and library breakdowns, bug-count and hop analyses, and LRM case study are unchanged in Figures 4-7 and Tables 5-6.

E5.justification: Table 2 retains identical descriptive variability summaries. Neither version reports repeated-run uncertainty, confidence intervals, or significance tests for model performance.

E6.justification: All numerical results and qualitative findings match, including Appendix E's Tables 7-10. For example, Table 3 retains DeepSeek-V3 cause-line accuracies of 48.3% for single-bug and 15.1% for multi-bug detection.

T1.justification: Section 3's formal task, input/output representation, matching criteria, and metric definitions are identical. No assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain identical claims about DSDBench's novelty, its construction framework, and current models' limitations in complex debugging.

C2.justification: Sections 4.2-4.5 retain the same interpretations of debugging difficulties and model behavior. The limitations concerning domain coverage and repository-level, multi-file debugging are also unchanged.

D1.justification: The API and decoding disclosures, annotation retry limit, and prompts in Appendices A-D are identical. The code/data access statement and embedded link destinations also match.

R1.justification: Section 5, Table 1's benchmark positioning, and the reference list are unchanged. No cited work or substantive relationship to prior research is added or removed.

P1.justification: Only the first-page marginal arXiv stamp changes from v1 dated 28 Mar 2025 to v2 dated 17 May 2025. The title, authors, prose, terminology, and section structure remain identical.

P2.justification: All figures, tables, captions, and placements match. Rendered pages 2-14 are identical; page 1 differs only in the version/date stamp text, without a layout change.

improvement.justification: The scientific content, experimental evidence, limitations, reproducibility information, and figure/table presentation are identical throughout both PDFs and their appendices. Updating the arXiv version/date stamp produces no meaningful difference in overall paper quality.
